title: StrategyEnumeratorOutput
description: H1 Wave-6 Pass-2 (2026-07-13) — Phase A global strategy enumeration. NEW instrument: whole-transcript-in, strategy-inventory-out. Distinct = own entry OR exit/management logic. Timeframe/confirmation-mechanic/target changes are VARIANTS within one strategy, not separate strategies. Per docs/designs/h1-wave6-pass2-two-phase-PACKET-2026-07-13.md §1.3 (verbatim).

strategies.description: Distinct strategies taught in this video. Distinct = own entry OR exit/management logic. Empty array is honest if no strategy is taught.

entry_summary.description: 1-2 sentence entry logic — the axis that must differ for another strategy to count as distinct from this one.

exit_summary.description: 1-2 sentence exit/management logic — the other distinctness axis.

variants.description: Configuration differences on THIS strategy's skeleton (timeframe / confirmation mechanic / target). NOT separate strategies. Empty array if the speaker teaches only one configuration.

transcript_quote.description: Optional locating quote for this variant — a hint for Phase B, not a hard grounding requirement (Phase B does its own quote-first grounding).

enumeration_note.description: Free-text flag for ambiguous cases, e.g. 'two variants share an identical skeleton, differ only in TF/confirmation/target'. Surfaced for the over-enumeration fence's review, never scored directly.
